notification_templates.result_failed: The first automatic recovery failed (still no traffic after restarting the tunnel)
notification_templates.result_not_executed: Automatic recovery could not run (the tunnel cannot be started or stopped)
notification_templates.retry_limited: WG Always Live will try again every {interval} seconds, up to {limit} times; you will be notified again once traffic is back and stable for 2 minutes.
notification_templates.retry_forever: WG Always Live will keep trying every {interval} seconds; you will be notified again once traffic is back and stable for 2 minutes.
notification_templates.retry_none: WG Always Live will not retry automatically; please handle it manually. You will be notified again once traffic is back and stable for 2 minutes.

tray.tooltip_stale: WG Always Live: status unknown (interface not updating)

main.removed: Monitoring removed; the WireGuard tunnel itself and its official settings were not changed
main.explain_stop: To stop the watchdog, stop the WG Always Live service in the system's service manager (administrator rights needed). Closing the window or quitting the interface does not stop monitoring and does not change any VPN. To stop monitoring for a while, use "Pause all monitoring" on the Settings page.

tunnels.hint: Green = a probe through this tunnel reached its recovery check target; "connected" alone does not mean traffic flows.
tunnels.empty: No tunnel registered yet. Press "Add tunnel" to pick from the tunnels the official WireGuard app already has.
tunnels.add_hint: Pick from the tunnels the official WireGuard app already has. A registered tunnel is only watched by default, never connected or disconnected; automatic recovery can be turned on once a recovery check target is set and has passed its first check.
tunnels.add_access_hint: Whether a tunnel is on this installation's access list is not judged in advance: after you press "Register", the watchdog's answer decides, and it is shown beside the tunnel.
tunnels.discovering: Looking for the official WireGuard app's tunnels…
tunnels.discovered_some: Found {count}, listed under "Add tunnel"; a registered tunnel is only watched by default, never connected or disconnected
tunnels.register_accepted: The watchdog accepted the registration; watch only by default
tunnels.register_no_answer: {text}; whether it was registered will show in the next status

notify.title: Telegram notifications
notify.hint: One notification when a tunnel drops unexpectedly and the first automatic recovery fails; one more each when automatic retries reach their limit, and when traffic is back after automatic recovery and stable for 2 minutes. Each kind is sent once per incident. Each tunnel's disconnect alerts can also be turned off on its card on the Tunnels page.
notify.device_note: Messages call this computer by this name. Up to 64 characters; a longer name is cut and ends in "...".
notify.device_host: Not set: messages use the host name {name}
notify.token_note: Cleared from the screen as soon as the watchdog has it; the screen only shows whether one is stored.
notify.token_clear_question: Clear the Bot Token? No notifications are sent until a new token is set.
notify.token_invalid: This is not a Bot Token (it should be digits:letters and digits)
notify.token_sent: Bot Token handed to the watchdog to store
notify.last_failure: The last notification was not delivered: {failure}
notify.templates_unknown: Message templates in use: unknown (watchdog unreachable)
notify.templates_ours_changed: Message templates in use: {name} (a different version from this interface's)
notify.templates_foreign: Language of Telegram notifications: {name} (not the interface's current language)
notify.templates_broken: This language file's message templates break the rules, so they were not handed to the watchdog
notify.templates_hint: The watchdog writes Telegram notifications with these templates, even while the interface is closed. They come from the interface's language file and update when you choose a language under Settings; a set in another language (chosen by another interface, or before the system language changed) is never replaced automatically. Press "Use the interface's current language" to replace it.
notify.recovered_note: After an automatic recovery the "Recovered" notification is sent once traffic has been back and stable for 2 minutes, so it comes a little after the actual recovery; a tunnel brought back by a manual connect or reconnect gets no such notification.
notify.preview_note: Shown with the current interface language's templates and sample values: the device name as set, the first tunnel in the list, and a sample incident number and times; the watchdog fills in the real ones when it sends.

mcp.title: MCP (operation by agents)
mcp.on: MCP is on: agents can operate WGAL through wgal-mcp
mcp.off: MCP is off: every agent request is refused
mcp.not_offered: Needs WatchDog 2.1.0 or later, with the watchdog reachable
mcp.hint: An agent acts as the account that runs it and can do what this window can (within the access list), but never gets the Bot Token, and gets the Chat ID only if allowed below; connect, disconnect and reconnect really start and stop the VPN. Every change an agent makes is logged and marked as coming from MCP.
mcp.telegram_on: Allowed: agents can read the Chat ID and change or clear the device display name, Chat ID and Bot Token
mcp.telegram_off: Not allowed (default): agents cannot read the Chat ID or change these settings
mcp.telegram_inactive: {state}. No effect while MCP is off; it applies again once MCP is on
mcp.telegram_needs_mcp: Turn MCP on first to change this
mcp.telegram_not_offered: Needs WatchDog 2.1.0 or later, with the watchdog reachable
mcp.telegram_hint: For security, agents can only set new values and read the device display name and Chat ID; the Bot Token can only be replaced, never read. A Bot Token you give an agent stays in the agent's conversation history, so for security we recommend setting it yourself.
mcp.setup: Add this local (stdio) server to the agent's MCP settings; it opens no network port.
mcp.clients_remove_question: This removes the entry named wgal from {path}; your other settings stay. Quit {client} first, then confirm.
mcp.clients_refused_not_there: {client}'s settings have no wgal entry; there is nothing to remove.
mcp.clients_unavailable: Could not read the AI tools' settings
mcp.clients_state_other: Has a wgal entry that runs another program: {path}
mcp.clients_state_no_folder: This tool's settings folder was not found; it may not be installed: {path}
mcp.clients_state_unreadable: This settings file cannot be changed automatically (it is a link, too large or not valid); add the preview below yourself: {path}
mcp.clients_question: This changes {path}. Quit {client} first, then confirm.
mcp.clients_claude_code_note: Claude Code keeps rewriting this file while it runs: quit every Claude Code.
mcp.clients_done: Added to {client}. Restart {client} so it reads WGAL.
mcp.clients_hint: Only the entry named wgal is added or updated; your other settings, their order and formatting stay, and a failed write is undone at once. No copy is kept: a settings file may hold other tools' keys. The window never runs these tools.
mcp.clients_no_server: wgal-mcp is not installed on this computer, so nothing can be set up.
mcp.clients_refused_no_folder: {client}'s settings folder was not found; nothing was written.
mcp.clients_refused_link: {client}'s settings file or folder is a link, so for safety nothing was written; add the preview yourself.
mcp.clients_refused_too_large: {client}'s settings file is too large; nothing was written. Add the preview yourself.
mcp.clients_refused_not_parsable: {client}'s settings file is not valid; nothing was written. Add the preview yourself.
mcp.clients_refused_changed: {client}'s settings file was just changed by another program; nothing was written. Quit {client} and try again.
mcp.clients_refused_io: Could not write {client}'s settings file; nothing was changed.
mcp.clients_refused_damaged: Writing {client}'s settings file failed and could not be undone; it may be damaged or incomplete. Open {path} and check it against the preview below.

settings_file.title: Settings file
settings_file.hint: Save the tunnel and host settings to a file: back them up before a change and import them to restore when something goes wrong, or move them to another computer. The file holds no device display name, Bot Token or Chat ID; the device name appears only in the file name.
settings_file.not_offered: Needs WatchDog 2.1.0 or later, with the watchdog reachable
settings_file.too_large: The file is too large to be a WGAL settings file
settings_file.not_json: This is not a JSON file, so not a WGAL settings file
settings_file.not_settings: This is not a WGAL settings file
settings_file.other_version: This is a version {version} settings file; this WGAL reads only version 1
settings_file.match_id: Tunnel ID (same computer, when names may repeat)
settings_file.match_hint: When matching by name, an entry matching more than one tunnel here is not applied; match by ID instead.
settings_file.register_missing: Also register tunnels the official WireGuard app has but WGAL has not registered yet
settings_file.monitor_new: Start monitoring newly registered tunnels right away
settings_file.previewing: Checking what the import would do
settings_file.previewed: This is what the import would do; press "Apply" to go ahead
settings_file.not_found: this computer has no such tunnel; cannot restore
settings_file.ambiguous: this computer has several tunnels with this name; cannot restore (match by ID instead)
settings_file.duplicate_in_file: the file lists it more than once; cannot restore
settings_file.unsupported: the official app does not let WGAL control it; cannot restore
settings_file.auto_waiting_for_baseline: automatic recovery turns on once the recovery check target passes its first check (within 10 minutes)

settings.pause_lost: The watchdog is unreachable, so monitoring cannot be paused or resumed
settings.pause_hint: While paused nothing is probed, no status is read and nothing is recovered automatically; the official VPN is not affected, and connect and disconnect still work. To pause one tunnel only, use the "Monitoring" switch on its card.
settings.workers_hint: At least 2, at most the number of monitored tunnels plus 1. Threads start only when there is work; a tunnel with monitoring paused is not probed and takes no thread.
settings.zone_in_use: The log and Telegram messages now use: {zone}
settings.zone_hint: Times in the log and in Telegram messages are written in this time zone; type part of a name and pick it from the list.
settings.save_lost: The watchdog is unreachable, so this cannot be saved
settings.language_note: Follows the system language by default; English when the system language is not in the list. A choice applies at once to every page and the tray, and keeps what you typed but have not saved; it also switches Telegram notifications to this language. Remembered on this computer, for this window only.
settings.language_applied_unsaved: Now using "{name}" (this computer cannot remember it; after the window closes it follows the system again)
settings.refresh_current: Now: refreshes every {secs} seconds; shows "Watchdog unreachable" after {lost} seconds without a status
settings.refresh_note: For this window only: how often it asks the watchdog for its status, and how often the Log page refreshes while open. Remembered on this computer; it does not change the watchdog. The longer the interval, the later changes and an unreachable watchdog are noticed. Applies as soon as you press "Save interface settings".
settings.refresh_invalid: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}
settings.refresh_applied_unsaved: Applied: refreshes every {secs} seconds (this computer cannot remember it; the default returns after the window closes)
settings.refresh_defaulted_unsaved: Default restored: refreshes every {secs} seconds (this computer cannot remember it)

dialog.external_title: Also start the tunnel when it is stopped from outside?
dialog.external_body: When on, WG Always Live may start this tunnel again even after the official WireGuard app or another tool turned it off by hand. If you sometimes disconnect on purpose in the official app, leave this off.
dialog.remove_body: Only WG Always Live's registration, targets and settings for it are deleted, and monitoring stops. The WireGuard tunnel itself and its official settings are not changed, and it is not connected or disconnected. You can register it again with "Add tunnel".

error_code.invalid_setting: The watchdog does not accept this value

error_reason.binding_lost: The official app no longer has this tunnel; register it again
error_reason.id_conflict: This tunnel ID now belongs to another tunnel; look again, then register it
error_reason.too_many_tunnels: The maximum number of tunnels is registered; remove one you no longer watch first
error_reason.too_many_discovered: The official app has more tunnels than can be listed at once
error_reason.managed_by_another_tool: Another manager controls this tunnel; WG Always Live does not take it over
error_reason.config_not_protected: This tunnel's configuration is not protected (accounts without administrator rights can change it), so it is not registered, for safety
error_reason.manager_query_failed: Cannot ask the official WireGuard app about this tunnel; try again later
error_reason.cannot_control: WG Always Live cannot start or stop this tunnel on this computer
error_reason.baseline_not_passed: The recovery check target has not passed its first check, so automatic recovery cannot be turned on yet
error_reason.operation_in_progress: WG Always Live has an operation under way on this tunnel (connect, disconnect or recovery); try again when it has finished
error_reason.unknown_time_zone: The watchdog does not know this time zone name
error_reason.storage_load_failed: The watchdog cannot read its saved settings; this change was not saved, so nothing gets overwritten
error_reason.storage_save_failed: Settings cannot be saved; the operation did not take effect
error_reason.secret_store_unavailable: The system's secure storage for the Bot Token cannot be reached
error_reason.test_notification_in_progress: The previous test notification is still being sent; try again shortly

error_reason.needs_administrator_or_listed_tunnel: Needs an administrator: this tunnel is not on the list the installer wrote, so it cannot be registered from here, and automatic actions (automatic recovery, starting when stopped from outside) cannot be turned on. error_reason.mcp_disabled: MCP is off: agent requests are refused. To let agents operate, turn MCP on under Settings.
error_reason.mcp_telegram_disabled: Agents are not allowed to set Telegram notifications: they cannot change the device display name, Chat ID or Bot Token. To allow it, go to MCP under Settings.
error_reason.shutting_down: The watchdog is stopping and did not do this
error_reason.too_many_waiting: The watchdog is busy and did not do this; try again
error_reason.not_running: The watchdog service is not running or not installed
error_reason.no_answer_in_time: The watchdog did not answer in time
error_reason.event_log_unavailable: The watchdog cannot read the event log right now
error_reason.not_available_here: This watchdog version does not offer this operation

error_reason.not_the_watchdog: What answered is not the WG Always Live watchdog service; nothing was sent

card.start_when_stopped_externally: Also start the tunnel when it is stopped from outside
card.observe_title: Watch-only targets (an issue never restarts the VPN)
card.observe_label: Watch-only targets (one per line, at most {max})
card.observe_placeholder: One per line: address or address:port
card.observe_note: An issue with a watch-only target never restarts the VPN.
card.targets_hint: IPv4 addresses only; DNS results are never used. Pick a VPN peer or piece of infrastructure that is always up; changing the recovery check target turns automatic recovery off until the target passes its first check again.
card.retry_mode_limited: Retry at most a set number of times
card.retry_hint: The first automatic recovery runs as soon as a fault is confirmed; after that it tries again at each retry interval. When the retries are used up, automatic recovery stops and a notification is sent; a manual connect or reconnect starts the count again.
card.external_hint: Off by default. When on, this tunnel may be started again even after the official WireGuard app or another tool turned it off on purpose.
card.remove_hint: Only WG Always Live's registration and settings for this tunnel are deleted; the WireGuard tunnel itself and its official settings are not changed, and it is not connected or disconnected.
card.port_without_target: A port also needs a recovery check target
card.why_binding_lost: The official app no longer has this tunnel; register it again
card.why_tunnel_paused: Monitoring of this tunnel is paused
card.why_no_target: Set a recovery check target first
card.why_auto_blocked: The recovery check target has not passed its first check, or this tunnel cannot be controlled
card.auto_pending: Imported settings: turns on once the recovery check target passes its first check (within 10 minutes of the import)
card.reason_lost: The watchdog is unreachable; the current status is unknown
card.expired: Result expired; waiting for the next update
card.expired_reason: The last success is older than its {secs}-second validity, so it does not mean everything is still fine
card.reason_paused_all: Monitoring paused (all tunnels); this does not mean the VPN is disconnected
card.notify_off_note: Telegram notifications are off on the Notifications page, so this switch has no effect for now
